name: The Crown's Guard
source:
You play as Eurys. Once a wanted convict, you were picked up from the streets by the young Prince Vinum and given another chance at life. The two of you become steadfast friends, sworn brothers, and maybe something more. After realizing your need to improve in arcane arts, you leave Fyor behind to further your studies up north. 

But only a few years after you leave, the witch dragon of Durgam suddenly attacks Fyor, laying waste to your home. To make things worse, the late queen dies shortly after. By the time you return, it's too late. The dust has settled, and the boy you swore to protect is forever changed. 

You resume your post as the crown's guard. But no matter how you try to fix your relationship with Prince Vinum, he regards you with nothing but stone cold indifference. Old enemies return with a vengeance, hell bent on destroying Fyor. Will you be able to get through to your best friend before it's too late?

[From [url=https://apricotrui.itch.io/thecrownsguard]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你扮演尤里斯。你曾经是一名通缉犯，后来被年轻的维努姆王子从街上捡起来，并获得了重生的机会。你们两个成为了坚定的朋友、结拜的兄弟，或许还有更多。在意识到自己需要提高奥术艺术之后，你离开费奥前往北方继续深造。

但就在你离开几年后，杜尔加姆的女巫龙突然袭击了费奥，把你的家园夷为平地。更糟糕的是，已故女王不久就去世了。等你回来的时候，已经太晚了。尘埃落定，你发誓要保护的男孩永远改变了。

你恢复了王室卫士的职位。但无论你如何努力修复与维努姆王子的关系，他对你的态度都是冰冷的冷漠。宿敌复仇归来，一心要消灭费约。你能在为时已晚之前与你最好的朋友取得联系吗？

[来自[url=https://apricotrui.itch.io/thecrownsguard]itch.io[/url]]
